answer_1.quote: we implement a community-driven initiative to develop parallel corpora which are essential for evaluating and creating machine translation (MT) systems.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we employ BLEU which calculates n-gram precision with a brevity penalty to account for translation length. We also use chrF for our baseline system which computes character-level ngram F-scores... We use the SacreBLEU implementation for both metrics.
